text: with fair branches: Heb. fair of branches
made him great: Or, nourished | set him up: Or, brought him up | little rivers: Heb. conduits
when he shot forth: Or, when it sent them forth
deal with him: Heb. in doing he shall do unto him
their trees stand up: Or, stand upon themselves for their height
to mourn: Heb. to be black
